cases.name: start
cases.title: close the reminders shown at the start

cases.name: text-tap
cases.title: finger: a tap places the cursor; a tap on the cursor shows and hides the menu

cases.name: text-double-tap
cases.title: finger: a double tap selects the word at the second touch; B and B again

cases.name: text-triple-tap
cases.title: finger: a triple tap selects the paragraph (without its end); B, B again

cases.name: text-long-press
cases.title: finger: a long press selects the word while the finger is down

cases.name: text-handles
cases.title: finger: the handles make the selection longer at either end

cases.name: text-tap-selection
cases.title: finger: a tap into the selection hides/shows the menu, outside ends it
